featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Makwana
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been learning Bharatanatyam here for the past 12 years, and it has been an incredible journey of learning and growth. The teaching method is systematic and detailed, with great discipline and constant encouragement from the teachers. The classroom ambience and facilities create a positive learning environment for students.

The institution provides wonderful performance opportunities across India, helping students grow as confident performers. The Arangetram duo rehearsals were a memorable and enriching experience, and the guidance for Visharad preparation and completion was extremely supportive and well-structured.

ATHARVOTSAV, the annual festival celebrating World Dance Day, is a beautifully organized event that gives students a great platform to showcase their talent. Truly grateful to be a part of this institution!

featured_reviews.name: Hrituja Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been learning in this institute 'Atharva School of Fine Arts' for the past 10 years under Guru Smt. Shamal Pawar, and it has been a wonderful journey. The teaching method is very supportive and disciplined, with great attention given to every student. The classroom environment is always positive, well-maintained and encouraging.
My journey at Atharva School of Fine Arts has been truly unforgettable. The training here goes far beyond just learning dance, it teaches discipline, confidence, dedication and values that stay with you for life. Shamal teacher has always guided every student with immense patience, encouragement and personal attention.

Over the years ,  for every exam teacher always took extra practice and extra efforts in taking us to perfection and also giving theoretical knowledge  , explaining every meaning and explained as many as times till we understand. One of the most special experiences for me was preparing for my Arangetram. Every rehearsal helped me improve not only as a performer but also as an individual.

The institute also provides amazing opportunities to perform at festivals  and cultural events across India , giving valuable stage exposure and confidence. ATHARVOTSAV is one of the most memorable part of my journey , my first stage performance was at Atharvotsav with my friends, it was a nice experience for me . This festival brings together artists from different places and creates a wonderful platform to celebrate dance and art.

I have grown a lot as a performerand also as a person , I feel extremely fortunate and truly grateful to be a part of this institution.
Thank you so much teacher and Atharva School of fine Arts.

featured_reviews.name: Manasvi Sarfare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being a student at Atharva School of Fine Arts for the last 9 years has been a very important and special part of my life. My journey in Bharatnatyam here has helped me grow not only as a dancer but also as a person.
Under the guidance of Guru Smt. Shamal Pawar, I have learned that Bharatnatyam is not just about dance, but also about discipline, hard work and values that stay with you for life. My teacher has not only taught me dance but has also helped shape my personality. She has made me more disciplined, confident and responsible both on and off stage.
The training here is very detailed and well planned. From practical classes and theory preparation to exams and performances, every student gets proper guidance, encouragement and support.
One of the most memorable parts of my journey was my Arangetram, because that is when I truly became a more confident dancer. My guru trained my dance partner and me for almost 6 months, helping us improve our stamina, stance and overall performance. She especially helped me with abhinaya, which was something I struggled with a lot. Every small mistake was corrected patiently, and she made sure we kept improving in every class. What made this experience even more special was that my guru made sure our Arangetram was budget-friendly while still being beautifully organised and well managed. It was a very meaningful and unforgettable experience for me.
Another wonderful part of learning here is the opportunities the school provides. Students get chances for performances, scholarships, auditions, and even opportunities to perform across India and abroad. The annual festival “Atharvotsav” is also one of the highlights of the year. It gives students and artists a great platform to perform, learn and gain confidence while celebrating this beautiful art form.

Classical dance is not always easy and there are many challenging moments, but having a teacher you can trust and learn from makes all the difference. Our guru has always guided and supported us with patience, discipline and encouragement.

For me, Atharva School of Fine Arts is much more than just a dance class. It is a place where I learned dance, discipline, confidence and grew into a better version of myself.

featured_reviews.name: TANISHKA SHINDE
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a student of Atharva School of Fine Arts, and I have been learning Bharatanatyam. My dance class has been a truly enriching and inspiring experience. Under the guidance of my guru, Smt. Shamal Pawar, I have improved my technical skills and developed a deeper understanding of dance as an art form. The environment is disciplined and encouraging, which helps me stay motivated.
The institute is well-maintained, hygienic, and fully air-conditioned, which makes learning comfortable and focused. It also provides valuable opportunities to perform at various platforms, helping us build confidence and showcase our talent.
A major highlight is Atharvotsav, a professionally organized program where students perform alongside trained artists. It gives us a wonderful platform to present our art in a professional setting. I am truly grateful to my parents for encouraging me to be a part of it and I am proud to be a student of this institution.

Character Rotation: Building Real Design Skills

Character rotation is more than drawing the same character from different angles. It helps students understand form, proportion, structure, volume, and spatial visualization which are essential skills used in animation, game design, illustration and product design.

This exercise teaches students how to think in 3D and maintain consistency across every view of a character.
